svg.text: Five role views describe the same TerraGuavd system.
Repeated shared cases represent the same functions.
Every operation is subject to backend permissions
and mission access. Account restrictions may remove
Field Personnel access missions listing them.
Field stop requests create alerts for the assigned
operator; they never command the aircraft directly.
Administrator and Supervisor roles do not grant
Live 3D is read-only and requires an active mission
